Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse
• Supplying materials to the production lines
• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

Do you have experience as an operator? 
Do you also know how to drive a forklift truck? 

Then we are looking for you!

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!

Your day consists of advising customers, carefully packing orders, and keeping the shop tidy and inviting. You make sure everyone feels welcome and radiate enthusiasm, even during busy moments. Together with your colleagues, you build a festive experience all year round.

Do you see yourself bringing a little Christmas magic every day? Apply quickly and become the new face of this atmospheric store in the heart of Bruges.

• You speak fluent English

• You have a good knowledge of Spanish

• You are customer-oriented, friendly, and communicative

• You are passionate about Christmas decorations and atmospheric products

• You work in an orderly way and have an eye for detail

• You are flexible and willing to work weekends (between 10 am and 6 pm)

• Experience in sales is a plus, but motivation and enthusiasm are just as important

jobs.occupation: Chauffeur at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Chauffeur to join the Executive Office.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder operates safely a fully armored vehicle to transport the Ambassador and Deputy Chief of Mission within the city and the surrounding areas. Reacts defensively in response to potential security threat-related situations. Analyses the daily appointment schedule, ensuring familiarity with both a primary and alternate route to the destination, as well as potential security concerns at destination.

EDUCATION: Completion of secondary school.

EXPERIENCE: 3 years of professional driving.

LANGUAGE: Good working knowledge in English. Good working knowledge in French or Dutch.

DRIVER'S LICENSE C

• After thorough training by an experienced colleague, you will independently perform cutting and bending operations.
• You will calculate flat patterns and program the sheet metal processing machines.
• Using technical drawings, you will learn to independently carry out various metalworking operations such as bending, cutting, deburring, tapping, and other machining processes on workpieces.

• You have an A2 degree in Mechanics or equivalent experience.
• You have knowledge of a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notcher, and punching machine.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• Good spatial insight is essential.
• You work accurately and can work independently after the training period.
• Order, cleanliness, and safety are second nature to you.
• English or Dutch.

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.
